summary: Minister's fishing contracts allocation without tender process; prima-facie corruption case; no evidence of bribe demand/acceptance by appellant; statutory presumption under s.20 requires proof of demand/acceptance; Neeraj Dutta precedent on necessity of proving demand/acceptance; policy deviation alone insufficient for corruption charge; High Court's refusal to quash proceedings challenged; discharge application rejected by lower courts.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; criminal proceedings quashed; discharge granted to appellant.
